title: Elf Bar Plus50 Blue Razz Lemonade Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Razz Lemonade from the Elf Bar Plus50 pod range offers a bright, fizzy twist on a berry favourite. Sweet-tart Blue Raspberry meets the sharp sparkle of Lemonade, delivering a flavour that’s juicy, zesty and unmistakably bold from start to finish. Each Plus50 pod contains 2ml of 20mg Nic Salt e-liquid and can join two other pods in the Elf Bar Plus50 Pod Kit, with no mess or fuss. The integrated mesh coil delivers consistently smooth performance with discreet vapour, ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping. Each pod is topped up via a prefilled 10ml refill pod, and together each pod and refill can deliver up to 5,500 puffs of flavour.
